Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated sandstone bluff for a low-poly Meshy game model.
Image 1 is the approved Custard Creek pool STYLE AND GEOLOGY reference. Extract the rich sculpted rock language of its LEFT bank into ONE freestanding massive rounded sandstone outcrop. This is a variant for an existing 3D scene that currently has overly smooth, repetitive blocky cliffs. Make a broad asymmetrical bluff approximately 1.2 times as wide as tall, with a rounded bowed front and deep solid sides. Three uneven strata, offset broad ledges, irregular chipped rim, shallow vertical erosion channels and restrained branching cracks. Large soft forms first, with convincing medium-scale broken rock detail and porous sandstone texture. The silhouette must be organic, not a cylinder, stack of slabs, rectangular block, masonry, or a spire. Top is a useful mostly flat rough ledge with sparse olive moss and a little earth in the cracks. No plants, trees or grass. Warm pale honey/peach sandstone, neutral albedo with gentle material variation; retain bright warm stone rather than dark orange/brown. No strong baked directional shadow. Professional richly textured stylized 3D game asset, economical topology but finely textured surfaces. Clear three-quarter front view slightly above, entire solid object with margin on a plain white studio background. No text, no water, no ground, no other objects.
